title: Ye sensor chhoone se nahi, garmi se chalta hai! 🔥 #shorts
description:
Button dabana nahi padta, bas chhoona hai... ya sach mein? HC-SR501 PIR sensor chhoone se nahi, garmi ke badlav se chalta hai!
Is Short mein 3D teardown aur signal diagram ke saath samjho.
🔍 Fresnel lens garmi ko focus karta hai
🌡️ Do hisse garmi ka badlav pakadte hain
📏 Range 3 se 7 meter
⏱️ Chalu karke lagbhag 1 minute ruko
👉 Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ko, har hafte ek naya module khulega!
#shorts #PIR #HCSR501 #Arduino #electronics #makers #sensor #hindi
